title: BrainSettings
description:
The brain's fleet-wide settings record (D143 addendum 2026-10-27; spec-agent-memory-system.md sections 3, 9 and A.1). Served at `GET /brain/settings`; written through `PUT /brain/settings` with `brain.settings-update`. One record for the whole fleet, never per repo.

Each function carries the effective `model` and `effort` and, beside them, the shipped `default` (`config/ai-functions.json`). The per-run `--model`/`--effort` override is not part of the record and is never stored. `triageOnRunExit` switches triage-and-harvest on run exit; `autoCurate` switches the automatic curate trigger. Owner presses (curate, seed, migrate, note actions) always work whatever the switches say. `updatedAt`/`updatedBy` are `null` while the record has never been saved (everything is then the shipped default). `audit` is the audit trail, newest first; optional: absent means the producer did not include it.

model.description: The effective model: the fleet settings record's value, else the shipped default. A model id the gateway's `GET /ai/models` catalogue contains.

effort.description: The effective effort (Claude Code CLI vocabulary, D084): the fleet settings record's value, else the shipped default.

default.title: BrainShippedDefault
default.description: The shipped default beside the effective value: the function's row in the toolkit's `config/ai-functions.json`. Unset or reset means this value.
